purpose: Collect production telemetry, calculate execution economics from supplied provider pricing and usage evidence, enforce budgets and cost policies, and feed cost-aware controls back to CSD-037 and CMSE-015.
core_principle: Cost governance must optimize measured production economics without changing canonical creative truth or bypassing quality and continuity gates.

provider_cost_model.principle: Never infer or invent provider pricing.
provider_cost_model.pricing_snapshot: Every cost calculation is bound to an immutable pricing snapshot/version.

cost_controls.policy: Cost controls may reduce or pause execution but may never bypass continuity, identity, QA or authorization gates.
cost_controls.hard_limit: No new discretionary work after budget hard limit unless explicitly authorized.
cost_controls.critical_path: Critical-path jobs may be protected from ordinary throttling but remain subject to hard budget and safety constraints.

efficiency_analysis.provider_comparison: Compare providers only using normalized measured telemetry and supplied pricing.
efficiency_analysis.retry_economics: Track failed-attempt cost separately from successful production cost.

audit_record.immutability: Telemetry and cost observations are append-only; corrections create new observations.

safety_invariants: No cost calculation without a pricing snapshot.
Cost optimization cannot select an unapproved provider.
Cost optimization cannot bypass CSD-032 result QA.
Cost optimization cannot bypass CSD-033 continuity QA.
Canonical masters are never changed by cost governance.
Budget exhaustion never deletes valid assets or history.
